name: General
ability: Each night, you learn which alignment the Storyteller believes is winning: good, evil, or neither.
learns: Good (thumbs up), evil (thumbs down) or neither (thumbs sideways), by the Storyteller's judgement at the moment the General wakes.
malfunction: If drunk or poisoned the Storyteller may give any of the three answers. The engine offers the other two answers as misinformation.

rulings.text: The judgement is made when the General wakes, so earlier events that night count.
Factors include living players on each side, the quality of good's information, how convincing evil's bluffs are, consensus on executions, and the Demon player's experience.
Thumbs sideways means the Storyteller does not know which team is winning.

tests.name: evil is winning
tests.setup: Alice General, Bob Chef, Cara Empath, Dan Monk, Finn Saint (good), Gus Imp (suspected), Eve Scarlet Woman (trusted). All alive.
tests.actions: Night 2: the Storyteller judges evil ahead.
tests.expected: Good, evil and neither are all offered; Alice learns evil.

tests.name: good is winning
tests.setup: Alice General, Bob Chef, Cara Empath, Gus Imp, Eve Poisoner (dead). Good has confirmed information.
tests.actions: Night 3: the Storyteller judges good ahead.

tests.name: wakes on the first night
tests.setup: Alice General, Bob Chef, Cara Imp, Dan Monk, Eve Baron.
tests.actions: Night 1: the Storyteller does not know who is winning.
tests.expected: Alice wakes on night 1 and learns neither.

tests.name: poisoned General
tests.setup: Alice General, Eve Poisoner, Cara Imp, Bob Chef, Dan Monk.
tests.actions: Night 2: Eve poisons Alice; the Storyteller believes good is winning.
tests.expected: Misinformation evil and neither are offered; the Storyteller picks evil and Alice learns evil.
